description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding {C}{C}.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Necron Warriors, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {6}.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, destroying a permanent.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each of your turns.
